Dear @{outputs('Create_item')?['body/SubmittedBy']},

Thank you for submitting your innovation idea through the Innovo Labs portal.

We’re pleased to confirm that we have received your submission successfully. Our team will now review your idea against the relevant campaign criteria and assess its potential.

If your submission progresses to the next stage, a member of the Innovo Labs team will be in touch with you directly.

Thank you for taking the time to share your idea with us. We appreciate your contribution and look forward to exploring innovative opportunities together.

Kind regards,
Innovo Labs Team
